## What this does

Replaces the 4-div Hadean/Archean/Proterozoic/Phanerozoic bar in
`/earth/#deeptime` with a real d3 ICS chart (172 intervals, click-to-zoom,
hover-to-highlight-ancestors). Every click writes a draft claim to
IndexedDB — never sealed by the browser.

## Architectural rules (F2 / F13)

- **F2 TRUTH** — Per-interval provenance is not provided by upstream. The
  provenance aside explicitly labels each age as DEFERRABLE.
- **F11 AUTH** — No `arif_init` call from browser. No operator/peer routes touched.
- **F13 SOVEREIGN** — Browser session is OBSERVE_ONLY. Sealing requires an
  OPERATOR-authority session; that lives in A-FORGE PR #2 (Hermes lane).
- **F1 AMANAH** — IndexedDB queue is browser-local and reversible (clearing
  site data deletes it). No sovereign write occurs.

## Schema

Draft-claim rows mirror `AAA/scripts/log_abstention.py`:

```jsonl
{"id":1,"ts":"2026-08-26T07:30:00.000Z","context":"earth › deeptime › Phanerozoic › Paleozoic › Cambrian","draft_claim":"ICS interval \"Cambrian\" covers 538.8–485.4 Ma","source_class":"RECEIVED","withheld_because":"Browser session is OBSERVE_ONLY. Sealing requires OPERATOR authority via Hermes lane."}
```
